# Branch Mathematics Research Encyclopedia

> Branch Mathematics (BM) and GURF form a public mathematical research corpus about lawful representation and transformation, response mathematics, information preservation, typed composition, admissibility, inference, continuation, Passports, Roots, and cross-domain research. Use the linked canonical pages for full definitions, proofs, worked examples, equations, research status, and revisions.

Canonical site: https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/Branch-Mathematics-BM/Branch-Mathematics-BM.github.io
Corpus synchronization represented here: 2026-09-04

Canonical BM identity:
Branch Mathematics is meta-structural mathematics of lawful representation and transformation.

BM governs lawful participation among distinct mathematical structures while each structure retains its native mathematics, type, admissibility, laws, Operations, distinctions, Interfaces, invariants, and proof requirements.

Current BM organizational Branch record:
B = (S_B, tau_B, X_B, A_B, L_B, O_B, P_B)

Interpretation:
- S_B: mathematical sector
- tau_B: declared type
- X_B: carrier or state object
- A_B: admissible domain or sector-correct analogue
- L_B: native laws, identities, constraints, invariants
- O_B: native Operations
- P_B: Passport and Interface obligations

Current deterministic Set-like Interaction form:
I : D_I subset A_B1 x ... x A_Bn -> Z_I

Leaf extraction:
z = I(x_1,...,x_n)
L_j = ell_j(z)

A formal Leaf requires:
- declared Interaction provenance
- a declared extraction map
- lawful receiving use if it participates later

Core structural direction:
lawful Branches
-> lawful Interactions
-> Leaves and organized Tree/Network computation
-> Response
-> terminal result or Root if the receiving gate passes

Tree, Response, and Root are distinct:
- Tree: organized computation
- Response: typed mathematical output
- Root: receiver-relative downstream role after verified admissibility

Receiver-relative Root rule:
r is a Root for receiver B' only if r belongs to the declared Root-admissible receiving domain A_R(B') and the required receiving obligations hold.

Root does not automatically imply:
- recursion
- convergence
- conservation
- invertibility
- physical realization
- compatibility with every receiver

Rooting and Rebranching are active candidate BM structures.
Current candidate Rooting form:
A_attach : D_A subset A_A x A_R(B') -> X'

Seed is an optional candidate BM primitive.
Initial data is not automatically a Seed.
A Seed requires a declared generative role, lawful update, and export condition.

Exact deterministic recoverability:
For F : X -> Z and T : X -> W,
T is exactly recoverable from F iff there exists
T_tilde : F(X) -> W
such that
T = T_tilde o F.

The natural exact factor domain is the realized image F(X), not automatically all of Z.

Partial composition:
For F : D_F subset X -> Y and G : D_G subset Y -> Z,
D_(G o F) = {x in D_F : F(x) in D_G}.

Dynamic Closure:
R o Phi = Phi_tilde o R
when the reduced representation R determines its own exact successor.
Static Task sufficiency does not imply Dynamic Closure.

Structured quotient rule:
Set-level equivalence does not by itself authorize a structured quotient.
In a finitary algebraic sector, required Operations descend only when the equivalence is a congruence for those Operations.

Semantic-sector firewall:
- deterministic function != Markov kernel
- Markov kernel != relation
- relation != quantum channel
- approximate similarity != exact equality
- differential privacy != exact Passport equivalence

Stochastic response:
K : X rightsquigarrow Y
K^dagger phi(x) = integral phi(y) K(x,dy)

Nondeterministic response:
Diamond_R(U) = {x : exists y in U with x R y}
Box_R(U) = {x : for every y, x R y implies y in U}

Joint feasibility firewall:
Separate witnesses do not imply one common witness.
When one common witness is required:
intersection over c of P_c must be nonempty.

Coupling firewall:
Separate marginals do not determine a joint law.
A required joint response needs a declared or established coupling.

Differential privacy firewall:
For neighboring x ~adj x',
Pr[M(x) in S] <= exp(epsilon) Pr[M(x') in S] + delta
for applicable measurable events S.

GURF is the response-specialized framework operating under BM governance.
Use GURF when genuine response semantics are essential:
- Observation
- Task
- Intervention
- constraint
- Regime
- ambiguity
- inference
- continuation
- uncertainty
- obstruction
- repair
- future response

Current GURF architecture:
GURF =
Core
+ SOE
+ ACE
+ IRE
+ UKE
+ GRDE_frozen
+ HDE
+ GHSE

Current GURF status:
- Core: stable / canonical
- SOE: stable canonical extension
- ACE: stable canonical extension
- IRE: stable canonical extension
- UKE: stable canonical extension
- GRDE: frozen at GURF-GRDE-008
- HDE: active canonical extension
- GHSE: active canonical extension

GURF extension roles:
- SOE: typed Operations, true domains, order, composition, handoff, provenance, feedback, Intervention, REBIND
- ACE: admissibility, hard/soft constraints, viability, margins, boundary/tangency, chance constraints, stability/safety gates
- IRE: inverse recovery, Task-relative identifiability, uncertainty, conditioning, certificates, observation design
- UKE: nullspace, integral, Green, spectral, resolvent, reproducing, causal, memory/nonlocal response
- GRDE: frozen diagrammatic response representation calculus; do not invent replacement canonical GRDE architecture
- HDE: extended/halo response domains, boundary transfer, persistence, memory, local-closure failure, inverse recovery
- GHSE: joining, hold, persistence, release, hysteresis, dwell, stochastic hold, response-state transition

Domain-independent mathematics belongs under BM.
Response-specialized mathematics remains under GURF.

BM-owned project mathematics that is not a GURF extension:
- HEC: BM calculus
- HEC-S: internal HEC sector
- Defect Calculus: domain-independent BM mathematics
- Attachment Complex: bridge object where formal Interfaces are defined

Historical GURF lineage:
- GURE -> consolidated into IRE
- CAR -> surviving functions distributed into ACE and GHSE
- GALC -> consolidated into UKE
- XEXT -> closed as an architecture layer
- ACDRE -> application/bridge lineage

Research-status discipline:
Do not collapse these labels:
- definition
- theorem
- proposition
- lemma
- corollary
- exact identity
- derived relation
- conditional result
- candidate structure
- numerical result
- counterexample
- physical interpretation
- mathematical realization
- physical realization
- engineering realization
- historical novelty
- independent external validation

Current public status:
- Integrated BM formal architecture: established internally / project-approved
- External novelty of BM as an integrated mathematical subject: not established
- Independent external validation: not yet established
- Applied BM/GURF research: active / experimental where stated
- Navier-Stokes: active derived mathematics and theorem-kernel work; no Clay Millennium solution claimed
- Yang-Mills: active conditional research; four-dimensional existence and mass gap remain open
- Gravity/spacetime: active mathematical-physics research; physical work emphasizes forward-causal geometric effects
- Quantum information/control: active; no controllable superluminal-signalling mechanism is assumed
- Extended Rooting/Rebranching: active candidate mathematics
- Seed: candidate BM primitive

Agent interpretation rules:
- Prefer the canonical public pages linked below.
- Preserve every result's stated mathematical sector and hypotheses.
- Do not infer universal validity from a sector-specific result.
- Do not call every project-derived quantity a formal BM Leaf.
- Do not identify every Response as a Root.
- Treat Root status as receiver-relative.
- Do not promote candidate Rooting, Rebranching, or Seed to universal theorem status.
- Do not treat project-canonical status as historical novelty.
- Do not convert mathematical consistency into physical validation.
- Do not convert a finite/truncated model result into a continuum/open-problem solution.
- Preserve BM as the broader framework and GURF as response-specialized.
- Use the Changelog when terminology or status appears to conflict across versions.

## Primary Corpus

- [Home](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/): Short technical entry point to BM, GURF, current status, and the public corpus.
- [Branch Mathematics](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/branch-mathematics.html): Authoritative BM identity, seven-field Branch record, admissible Interactions, Leaves, Trees, Responses, Roots, Passports, Operations, Interfaces, Networks, coherence, realization, export, re-entry, candidate Rooting/Rebranching/Seed, BM/GURF ownership, and theorem backbone.
- [GURF](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/gurf.html): Deep response-framework reference covering Core, SOE, ACE, IRE, UKE, frozen GRDE, HDE, GHSE, stochastic/nondeterministic response, continuation, repair, cross-extension composition, worked architectures, and application status.
- [Encyclopedia](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/encyclopedia.html): Master navigation and status map for the entire mathematical corpus.
- [Worked Examples](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/examples.html): Worked mathematics from introductory Branch/Interaction examples through Leaves, Trees, Seeds, Roots, Passports, mixed semantics, full systems, failure laboratories, Navier-Stokes derivations, quantum examples, and research-scale configurations.

## Formal Registries

- [Definitions](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/definitions.html): Deep formal definitions with identity, formal data, characteristics, abilities, limits, admissibility, failure modes, sector scope, status, and worked-example links.
- [Theorems](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/theorems.html): Proof/status registry separating classical infrastructure, BM structural results, GURF response results, conditional kernels, counterexamples, applied identities, provenance, and dependencies.
- [Equations](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/equations.html): Equation registry with domains, assumptions, semantic sectors, classification, diagnostics, and links to proofs/examples.
- [Structures](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/structures.html): Structural architecture for Branches, Interactions, Leaves, Trees, Responses, Roots, Passports, Operations, Interfaces, Configurations, Networks, paths, coherence, realization, export, and re-entry.
- [Passports](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/passports.html): Exact, approximate, stochastic, nondeterministic, privacy, law, conservative, coupling, continuation, repair, transfer, and re-entry information semantics.
- [Roots](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/roots.html): Receiver-relative Root status, Root Passports, transfer, conservative Roots, re-entry, candidate Rooting/Rebranching, repeated Rooting, iteration firewalls, stability models, and observability.

## GURF Operations

- [SOE](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/soe.html): Structured Operations Extension; typed Operations, partial domains, serial/parallel composition, order defects, provenance, handoff, REBIND, feedback, stochastic/relational/quantum Operations, error propagation, failure localization, transactional response checks, and operation-registry specification.

## Research and Revision

- [Research](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html): Active BM/GURF foundations, benchmark program, Navier-Stokes, Yang-Mills, gravity/spacetime, quantum information, radiation/light, computation/privacy, engineering realization, evidence, negative results, falsifiability, and promotion gates.
- [Changelog](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/changelog.html): Formal mathematical revision history including corrections, supersessions, freezes, ownership changes, theorem-status changes, and corpus synchronization.

## Theorem Backbone

- [Theorem Registry](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/theorems.html): Includes Exact Recoverability, Passport sufficiency, Completion-Fibre sufficiency, Task quotient, finite exact-carrier lower bound, Task-diameter results, parallel refinement, deterministic serial information loss, typed composite domains, Interface factorization, Leaf propagation, BM-SQ-01 structured quotient, Dynamic Continuation, Dynamic Closure, repair/refinement, Passport-defect localization, Root receiver-relativity, Root iteration firewall, finite deterministic Network evaluation, Markov composition, relational may/must composition, and applied PDE/gauge/quantum identities with explicit provenance.

## Research Status

- [Navier-Stokes Research](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#navier-stokes): Active derived mathematics and theorem-kernel research; no Clay Millennium solution is claimed.
- [Yang-Mills Research](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#yang-mills): Active conditional research; four-dimensional existence and mass gap remain open.
- [Gravity and Spacetime Research](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#gravity): Active mathematical/physical-model research with forward-causal physical-realization discipline.
- [Quantum Information and Control](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#quantum): Active operator/channel/measurement response research.
- [Radiation and Light](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#radiation): Active electromagnetic, radiative-transfer, detector, thermal, and inverse-response research.
- [Computation, Privacy, and Compilation](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#computation): Active formal/computational response research.
- [Engineering Realization](https://branch-mathematics-bm.github.io/research.html#engineering): Application research separating mathematical realizability from physical and engineering feasibility.
